CANDIDATE'S CUE CARD Task 4
THE EXCURSION
The Overseas Students' Club is organising an excursion to a local tourist spot.
You are thinking of joining the exursion. Your examiner is one of the organisers.
Ask the examiner about:
- destination
- means of transport
- length of excursion
- cost
- meals
- clothing/equipment
